process_notes: RULE 1 (paid for in cycles): a static mechanism is NOT a diagnosis until its predicted population has been COUNTED. Three T123(a) branches died exactly here -- each accurate about the code, and empty in fact.

RULE 2: no branch may be closed by an UNEXAMINED INFERENCE. Cycle 5 discarded the natural-key family -- the RIGHT family -- on 'a natural-key match would leave the count matched'. False: a key match that skips the create WITHOUT REWIRING THE REFERENT leaves the count short AND the reference null.

RULE 3: on any count shortfall, the DESTINATION-SIDE GUID DIFF is the FIRST read, not the fifth. Four source-side queries inferred and failed; one destination diff named the object, and its zero-extra column simultaneously proved nothing had been regenerated under a new GUID.

RULE 5 (INSTRUMENTS ARE CODE): a pinning test must be PROVEN to fail against the commit it pins -- run it against the old code and report both outcomes. The cycle-8 test SET sense.MorphoSyntaxAnalysisRA = out and then asserted it, passing a half-done fix through a two-halves gate. Related: a recorded value that nothing COMPARES is not a pin (T129), and a file:line with no tree+HEAD is not a citation (RULE 4). All three are the same failure class -- something that looks like evidence and is not.

RULE 4 (TREE-QUALIFICATION -- bit three times this spurt): every file:line citation MUST state its tree and `git rev-parse HEAD`. src/gramtrans/Lib/categories.py is 10,165 lines on main and 16,022 on the branch. Cost: an entire re-diagnosis performed against main's superseded copy (which predates the _POS_ABSENT rewrite), a hardcoded insertion point that had moved twice, and a Pyright signature scare reproducible only under a stale editable install resolving against main's 6-arg signature. ANCHOR EDITS BY FUNCTION NAME, never by an inherited line number.
